comparison_experiment.note: Parent coordinator live experiment uses this public ISO. This inventory describes bf4c4f5, not ed92471; reconcile against the image before using it for coverage claims.

policy.null_fields: Unbound plan values; fill in a per-run copy before execution.

row_defaults.reason: Plan only; no candidate execution recorded.
row_defaults.precondition: Exact candidate in a disposable VM; current screenshot inspected.

feature.action: Exercise named feature through real input with known disposable data.
feature.expected: Visible behavior and actual data/state match the pinned source contract.

boot.action: Select the entry by keyboard for firmware/media/entry named in the ID.
boot.expected: Live desktop and Genkan usable; retain kernel, graphics, mounts and logs; reconcile any absent advertised entry.

gui-install.action: Complete normal Genkan GUI install for firmware/selection named in the ID; Aizome default and password login.
gui-install.expected: Exact review, real success and disk-only boot; all-six uses GDM; default-aizome and five-without-gnome use Aizome greeter.

storage.action: Install and disk-boot the explicit matrix cell encoded by ID.
storage.expected: Match filesystem, partitioning, swap/encryption and bootloader. Native 4K BIOS must be refused before writes with unchanged whole-disk hash. Encrypted success cases also reject wrong passphrase safely.

settings.action: Find pane/entry in settings_entries, or the named pane-level cancel/error case; exercise and reopen.
settings.expected: UI/backend agree; persistence matches contract; read-only or managed values labelled accurately.

menu.action: Follow exact Tatami menu/label from tatami_menu_entries and exercise action.
menu.expected: Correct action/submenu, search, keyboard access, Escape/back, safe cancellation and recoverable errors.

shortcut.action: Use chord and intended context identified by source in tatami_bindings; compare help and menu route.
shortcut.expected: Action occurs once in correct context, stays scoped to Tatami; input/focus remains correct.

catalog.action: Select named catalog application, enter named desktop, launch advertised entrypoint and complete an authored local functional task.
catalog.expected: Package, entrypoint, fonts, input, graphics and session integration work. Account-only functionality remains untested without dedicated test identity.

hardware.action: Exercise named device with suitable emulation and separately on physical test hardware.
hardware.expected: Actual device behavior established; missing-device UI alone is not proof.

publication.action: Do not publish, prune or enable release workflow.
publication.reason: Experimentation requested, not publication; a future publication needs the full skill and independent audit.
